_comment: Used ONLY by Stryker's sandbox (see stryker.config.mjs).
Stryker copies the mutated files and their dependencies into
`.stryker-tmp/sandbox*/` and runs vitest there. The repo's tsconfig.json
by `wxt prepare` and is not copied into the sandbox. The result was that
esbuild could not resolve the extends and every one of the 54 test files
failed to load — 54/54 failures before a single mutant was generated.
This config inherits `.wxt/tsconfig.json` directly so the relative path
resolves from the repo root, and adds the settings the sandbox needs.
It is deliberately NOT a replacement for tsconfig.json: `pnpm compile` still
